summary: This unit reconciles three bodies of work that had drifted into separate frames, so the project carries ONE coherent terminal state. (1) Route (b) 0269-0285 attacked the 'terminal face' (the 0276 S-diff gate / sparse-face window exclusion at the frontier) and closed TERMINALLY (0284 antecedent false, 0285 pervasive-face refuted / sparse-face not excluded). (2) The live [S1]/A1 log (E1-E19) and A1Growth.lean (0207-0209) work the SAME object from the wire side: the A1 clause the W2B3 assembly consumes (a uniform K on the DN walk = S-at-zeros), its proven growth form, and its NAMED-but-NOT-CLOSED absolute form ('the face', face_unbounded). (3) RHEnd.lean states the actual one-clause endpoint on the zero set, whose NAMED RESIDUAL is exactly G-hs1 (the S1 zero-side witness = the E1 content = the A1 walk bound, 'whose uniform face is S1Uniform'), the window zero-exclusion face, and G-hs3-left. FINDING: these are the same open problems viewed from three angles, not three different gaps.
